data.heading: Mastering Modern CSS & Visual Aesthetics
data.subtitle: Discovering OKLCH, Premium Layouts, and High-fidelity Web Animations
data.speakerNotes: Welcome back! Today we are exploring visual design, premium layouts, and how OKLCH allows us to build state-of-the-art websites. Let's dive in!

data.heading: Why Visual Aesthetics Matter

items.detail: Users judge a website within 50 milliseconds. Premium colors, balanced typography, and clean spacing establish trust immediately.
Unlike RGB or HSL, OKLCH matches how human eyes perceive brightness. Changing hue doesn't make colors look muddy or overly bright.
Subtle hover offsets, smooth spring transitions, and interactive visual cards keep users delighted and highly focused.

data.speakerNotes: Discuss the 50ms rule of web aesthetics. Click each item to show detailed insights.

data.heading: Color Space Comparison

tabs.label: HEX / RGB
tabs.content: Hexadecimal and RGB are standard format options in classical CSS. However, they represent how hardware screens display color, not how humans perceive it. Adjusting brightness or contrast mathematically is extremely difficult.

tabs.label: HSL Color Space
tabs.content: HSL (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) was a massive leap forward for readability. However, it suffers from a major flaw: yellow looks perceptually much brighter than blue at the same lightness value, leading to unpredictable contrasts.

tabs.label: OKLCH Color Space
tabs.content: OKLCH (Lightness, Chroma, Hue) is the modern standard. It ensures consistent perceptual lightness across all hues. A lightness of 70% will always look equally bright to the human eye, regardless of hue color selection.

data.speakerNotes: Toggle between the tabs to compare the code and benefits of each system. Emphasize that OKLCH is now supported in all major browsers.

data.heading: Evolution of Web Colors

events.title: Web-Safe Hex Colors
events.description: Screens only supported 256 colors. Developers were restricted to 216 'web-safe' hex codes to avoid visual dithering.

events.title: 16-Million Colors (RGB)
events.description: TrueColor displays become standard. CSS introduces rgba() allowing transparent overlays.

events.title: HSL Support Arrives
events.description: CSS3 introduces HSL, allowing designers to tweak lightness and saturation naturally.

events.title: OKLCH & Wide Gamuts
events.description: CSS Color Module Level 4 introduces OKLCH, enabling P3 wide gamuts and uniform color lightness.

data.speakerNotes: Scroll through the timeline. Note how fast technology has evolved from restricted 256 colors to modern wide P3 color spaces.

data.heading: Building an Aesthetic Palette

steps.title: 1. Pick a Lightness Range
steps.content: Define your surface background lightness and primary text lightness to ensure accessible contrast values (at least 4.5:1 ratio).
steps.tip: Aim for a Lightness of 98% for clean light surfaces, and 18% for deep rich dark backgrounds.

steps.title: 2. Define a Semantic Primary Hue
steps.content: Choose a main signature color for accents, links, active states, and buttons.
steps.tip: Sunset theme uses oklch(55% 0.18 25) which gives a gorgeous rich coral hue!

steps.title: 3. Derive Secondary Colors via Hue Shifting
steps.content: Create complementary colors by shifting the hue parameter (e.g. add or subtract 30-40 degrees on the hue wheel).
steps.tip: This guarantees a matching aesthetic harmony without random color selection.

data.speakerNotes: Walk students through the color wheel math. Show how easily OKLCH solves color theory.

data.heading: Visual Design Check

questions.question: Which color parameter determines how humans perceive brightness consistently?
questions.explanation: Lightness in OKLCH ensures uniform perceived brightness, preventing yellow from looking brighter than blue at identical settings.

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of Wide Gamut P3 colors?
options: 30% more vibrant and deep colors on modern displays
questions.explanation: P3 gamuts unlock extremely saturated shades of green, red, and blue that were completely unrenderable on older sRGB screens.

data.speakerNotes: Assess the class's understanding. Prompt them to raise their hands and vote.

data.heading: HSL vs. OKLCH Side-by-Side

left.title: HSL Space
items: Yellow is perceptually brighter than blue
Prone to contrast failures during mode switches

data.verdict: OKLCH is highly recommended for modern design systems and automated color generation pipelines.
data.speakerNotes: Walk through HSL flaws vs OKLCH solutions. Ask: 'Has anyone seen contrast issues on their screens?'

data.heading: Aesthetic Core Terms

cards.back: The perceptual brightness of a color, ranging from 0% (black) to 100% (white).
The saturation or intensity of the color. 0 represents pure gray, and 0.4 represents highly intense colors.
The color type or angle on the color wheel, ranging from 0 to 360 degrees (0 is red, 120 green, 240 blue).
Fitting vivid colors into screen limits cleanly without causing ugly visual clipping or pixelation.

data.speakerNotes: Let students click the cards to memorize these definitions. A vital glossary for visual web designers!

data.heading: Thiết kế Bento Grid Đột phá

items.title: Bố cục bất đối xứng cao cấp
items.content: Sắp xếp thông tin linh hoạt dưới dạng các ô lưới kính mờ Glassmorphism. Mỗi ô đại diện cho một chủ thể khác nhau, giúp tối ưu diện tích hiển thị và thu hút ánh nhìn.

items.title: Hiệu ứng Neon Glow
items.content: Tự động phát sáng mờ khi di chuột, nâng cấp trải nghiệm tương tác trực giác.

items.title: Màu sắc OKLCH
items.content: Đảm bảo độ tương phản hoàn hảo và chuyển màu mượt mà trên mọi màn hình rộng.

data.speakerNotes: Giới thiệu xu hướng Bento Grid trong thiết kế hiện đại. Chỉ ra cách sắp xếp các ô có kích thước linh hoạt.

data.heading: Sơ đồ Quy trình Hoạt động

nodes.label: 1. slide.json
nodes.details: Định nghĩa nội dung slide tối giản dưới dạng cấu trúc dữ liệu JSON.

nodes.label: 2. build.js
nodes.details: Compiler đóng gói các thành phần CSS/JS thành một tệp HTML duy nhất.

nodes.label: 3. renderer.js
nodes.details: Chuyển các khối dữ liệu JSON thành cấu trúc HTML ngữ nghĩa.

nodes.label: 4. Slide Deck
nodes.details: Tệp slide HTML hoàn thiện, chạy offline với đầy đủ hiệu ứng tương tác.

data.speakerNotes: Nhấp chuột vào từng node trên sơ đồ để hiển thị chi tiết các bước vận hành của hệ thống.

data.heading: Visual Masterclass Wrap-up
items: Always prioritize accessible color contrast ratios (4.5:1 minimum)
Utilize OKLCH to build predictable dark/light mode adaptations
Keep animations micro and smooth (between 150ms and 300ms)
Leverage modern layouts (CSS Grid + Container Queries) for clean hierarchy
